title: East Turkestan Republic
capsule: The Second East Turkestan Republic was a short-lived Soviet-backed revolutionary state proclaimed in 1944 in the three northern districts of Xinjiang (Ili, Tarbagatai, Altai). Led by figures such as Ehmetjan Qasimi, it fielded a national army and pursued Uyghur and Turkic self-determination against the Chinese Nationalist government. Its leadership perished in a 1949 plane crash en route to Beijing, and the territory was absorbed into the People's Republic of China that year.
